life ain't fair. no matter where u go. nepotism. favouritism. bigotry. everywhere. people looking down there nose at me bc of where i'm from
bc of who i am
so i... started 2 get stupid. started 2 do things i regret now. started 2 lash out in stupid ways. if they wanted 2 take from me? i'd take from them
bc if they weren't watching my back, why was i gonna watch theirs? so i was looking out for myself, and myself ONLY, read me?
i wasn't stealing shit. wasn't breaking protocol. i was a good lil soldier. but if u've ever heard the phrase 'malicious compliance' u get my vibe
there wasn't a 2nd of my life that i was gonna spend going above or beyond for nobody, ever. i wanted 2 do my time n get out with my checks
then it all went wrong. we're on a mission. n i'm on observation. i can see from my POV that the opps - the opposition - they suddenly start scrambling 4 us. they know we're there

arthur n the rest of the troops r down on the field, n i have a split second 2 decide. i can give away my position 'n fire on the scrambling opps 2 give His Maj n company warning n time 2 get 2 safety
but doing that puts me in real shit. guarantees those opps r comin' for my dumb arse real fast. so...
i pack up my shit n radio that we've been compromised... figured His Maj and the others r toast anyway...
i go to leave the room where i've been hiding out n i turn a corner right into the business end of some opp's rifle
nah, cuz. they knew i was there the whole time. they had the read on me from the start
they drag my ass out 2 the street. shove me 2 my knees n shove a pistol 2 the back of my head
BLAP BLAP
its fkin' arthur. fkin' His Maj rollin' out of nowhere 2 save me
n i was SO FKIN' MAD at him 4 it. got up 2 my feet n told him off right there
Because you were willing to leave him to die, but he wasn't willing to leave you?
Because you owed him your life, now?
YES
FK
don't u GET IT?! i was living my life 4 me n my fam. that's what mattered 2 me. the only thing that mattered 2 me
n now... now i got this mfer - this MFER - and now i have 2 CARE ABOUT WHAT HAPPENS 2 HIM
n THAT WASN'T PART OF THE PLAN
so when his ass GETS US INTO SERIOUS SHIT A FEW MONTHS LATER, n he's about to get DISCHARGED?!
I GOTTA CHOOSE. do i fkin' tell the brass a bunch of lies? do i throw him under the bus like i did b4? or do i do the RIGHT THING
i do the RIGHT FKIN THING BECAUSE I OWE HIM n i... i leave the army w/ him, n... n kiss that dream of college goodbye
that whole dream of mine of making a better life 4 me n my fam? gone. but arthur says 'naaaaah m8, it'll be ok'
'i got us set up with this new position with a peacekeeping org. n they pay better, n up front. ur gonna be ok'
so off i went 2 go join the ICR with him LIKE THE IDIOT THAT I WAS

but i can't just... walk away. that time's long gone, innit? couldn't walk away then... can't walk away now...
every time i let someone in, i end up their lil toy soldier...
so when u showed up... n stomped right in...
kicked in the doors i'd bolted shut...
